financings_after_balance_sheet.what: July 2026 public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants, including full exercise of the underwriters' option
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: We received aggregate proceeds of approximately $143.8 million, or approximately $134.8 million after deducting the underwriters’ discount and commissions and estimated offering expenses.

warrants.quote: The Company has pre-funded warrants outstanding to purchase an aggregate of 6,792,559 shares of the Company’s common stock as of June 30, 2026.
